SELECT h."name" AS hotel_name,
       lf."feature" AS feature
FROM "hotel" h
JOIN "city" c ON c."id" = h."city_id"
JOIN "roomtype" rt ON rt."hotel_id" = h."id"
JOIN "featureinroom" fr ON fr."roomtype_id" = rt."id"
JOIN "leisurefeature" lf ON lf."id" = fr."leisurefeature_id"
WHERE LOWER(c."name") = LOWER('New York')
  AND LOWER(lf."feature") LIKE '%swimming%'

UNION


SELECT h."name" AS hotel_name,
       lf."feature" AS feature
FROM "hotel" h
JOIN "city" c ON c."id" = h."city_id"
JOIN "roomtype" rt ON rt."hotel_id" = h."id"
JOIN "featureinroom" fr ON fr."roomtype_id" = rt."id"
JOIN "leisurefeature" lf ON lf."id" = fr."leisurefeature_id"
WHERE LOWER(c."name") = LOWER('New York')
  AND LOWER(lf."feature") LIKE '%hot tub%'

    c."name" AS city_name,
    lf."feature" AS feature
FROM "hotel" h
JOIN "city" c ON c."id" = h."city_id"
JOIN "roomtype" rt ON rt."hotel_id" = h."id"
JOIN "featureinroom" fr ON fr."roomtype_id" = rt."id"
JOIN "leisurefeature" lf ON lf."id" = fr."leisurefeature_id"
WHERE LOWER(c."name") = LOWER('New York')
  AND (
        LOWER(lf."feature") LIKE '%swimming%'
     OR LOWER(lf."feature") LIKE '%pool%'
     OR LOWER(lf."feature") LIKE '%hot tub%'
     OR LOWER(lf."feature") LIKE '%jacuzzi%'

ORDER BY h."name", lf."feature";
